dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: You see that stuff that popped out of the robots? That was PAINT.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: D-pad down picks HEAL paint, R1 sprays it. A little paint heals you right up.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: And D-pad up + R1 while standing still makes a checkpoint. Wow-ee.
